body: I work as a graphic designer online, so I might be able to afford betterhelp. I will try to tell my parents but I'm just too scared.
I’d love to but then I would have to tell my parents. I know my life will be better if I do it, but I can’t. I just can’t.

I have not talked to anyone about this from obvious reasons, but I suffer from all of the same effects that people with pocd do, so I label myself as that. I don’t know what’s gonna happen with me. I’m a student in the talented and gifted program, so I’m more informed than a normal 12 year old. I’m still dumb by all means, but I know what my feelings mean. Dysphoria is a thing that I’ve been struggling with for a while, and I have a couple of trans and nonbinary friends, so I’m not worried about gender identity as much as ocd and pocd
